## Hero

AI enablement & consulting · Orlando, FL

### Reclaim the hours your business is quietly losing.

We build the voice agents, automations, and websites that take repetitive work off your team — and keep running after everyone has gone home.

45-minute call. No prep. You leave with a ranked plan whether or not you hire us.

### Example: after-hours line booking an assessment, unattended

Illustrative transcript of a deployed voice agent (inbound, after hours):

- agent (00:00): Sarran AI Solutions, after-hours line. What can I help you with?
- caller (00:05): I run a dental practice. I want to find out where AI could make us more efficient.
- agent (00:12): That's our AI Readiness Assessment — 45 minutes, nothing to prepare. I have Thursday at 9:30.
- caller (00:21): Thursday works.
- agent (00:24): Booked. The calendar invite is on its way to your email.
- booked (00:27): Thu 9:30 AM · AI Readiness Assessment · booked without a human

## What We Build

Start with the assessment if you don't know where to begin. Start anywhere else if you do.

### Four ways we take work off your plate

#### AI Assessments & Strategy (Entry point)

An AI Readiness Assessment is a structured review of where AI can save time in your business. In a 45-minute discovery call, we map how work moves through your week, then rank 3–7 practical opportunities by likely time saved, tool cost, and speed to launch. You receive a written plan you can run yourself, not a pitch deck.

- 45-minute discovery call, nothing to prepare
- 3–7 ranked opportunities, quick wins first
- Tool costs verified, not estimated
- A four-day start plan you own

**Explore Entry Point:**

An AI Readiness Assessment is a structured review that identifies where artificial intelligence can save time, reduce repetitive work, or improve customer response without adding unnecessary operational risk. Sarran AI Solutions begins with one 45-minute discovery call covering the tasks, handoffs, delays, and systems that shape a normal working week.

Each opportunity is evaluated across four factors: potential time saved, implementation effort, recurring tool cost, and the level of human oversight required. The resulting written plan ranks 3 to 7 opportunities, explains the reasoning behind their order, verifies expected software costs, and identifies a practical four-day starting plan.

Recommendations may include voice agents, workflow automation, AI-assisted intake, reporting, follow-up, or web-based qualification. The client owns the plan and can implement it independently or ask Sarran AI Solutions to build selected systems. The full assessment is designed to take about one week while requiring very little additional client time.

Detail page: https://www.sarranai.com/ai-readiness-assessment.html

#### Intelligent AI Voice Agents (Always on)

An AI voice agent is a phone-based system that can answer calls, qualify callers, and book appointments directly into an existing calendar. Sarran AI Solutions designs inbound and approved outbound workflows that can operate 24/7, including after hours, while preserving transcripts and call-level reporting for review.

- 24/7 inbound answering and qualification
- Real-time booking into your existing calendar
- Outbound follow-up and reminder calls
- Full transcripts and call-level reporting

**Explore Always On:**

An intelligent AI voice agent is a phone-based system designed to handle approved conversations consistently, including when a team is busy or the business is closed. The implementation begins by defining the calls the agent may answer, the information it may collect, the questions it must ask, and the situations that require transfer or human follow-up.

The agent can qualify inbound callers, answer approved questions, schedule appointments in an existing calendar, and run permitted outbound reminders or follow-up calls. Each conversation can produce a transcript and call-level record so the business can review what happened, identify exceptions, and refine the workflow.

Production controls are designed before launch. Integrations receive only the access they need, sensitive actions use explicit confirmation, and uncertain or high-impact situations are escalated to a person. The result is extended call coverage without asking the system to make decisions outside its defined role.

Detail page: https://www.sarranai.com/ai-voice-agents.html

#### Next-Gen Web Design & Development (Front door)

AI-integrated web development combines a performance-focused business website with targeted AI functions such as visitor qualification, request routing, and instant answers. Each function is added only where it shortens a real user journey or conversion path, rather than appearing as an unrelated chat feature.

- Performance and Core Web Vitals as a build requirement
- Conversion paths designed around your booking funnel
- AI assistance embedded where it shortens the path
- Built for you to update without calling us

**Explore Front Door:**

An AI-integrated website combines a fast, accessible marketing site with focused automation that helps a visitor reach the right answer or next step. The work starts with the conversion path: what the visitor needs to understand, which questions indicate fit, and where a request should be routed.

AI is added only where it removes friction. Appropriate uses can include answering questions from approved business content, collecting qualification details, routing an inquiry to the correct service, or preparing structured information for a booking request. The website remains usable when an AI feature is unavailable, and important actions stay behind deterministic application rules rather than model judgment.

The underlying build prioritizes responsive layout, semantic HTML, accessibility, and Core Web Vitals. Technical SEO is designed in from the start through crawlable content, descriptive titles and metadata, canonical URLs, structured data, intentional internal linking, sitemap and robots directives, and answer-ready page structure for traditional and AI-assisted search. Content and conversion controls are designed so the business can update routine information without depending on a developer for every change. These foundations improve discoverability and indexing without making unsupported ranking guarantees.

Detail page: https://www.sarranai.com/ai-web-development.html

#### Workflow & Task Automation (Back office)

Workflow automation uses scheduled or event-triggered systems to complete repeatable business tasks without manual handoffs. Common candidates include intake, data entry between systems, reporting, invoicing, and follow-up. The automation runs unattended when rules are satisfied and escalates exceptions that require a person.

- Back-office and operational workflows
- Runs on schedule or on trigger, unattended
- Escalates to a person on exceptions
- Built on tools you already pay for where possible

**Explore Back Office:**

Workflow and task automation connects repeatable business steps so information can move, calculations can run, and routine follow-up can happen without manual copying between systems. A workflow may start on a schedule or from an event such as a submitted form, a changed record, an approaching due date, or a completed appointment.

The design documents the trigger, required inputs, business rules, permitted system access, expected output, and exception path before implementation. Suitable workflows can support intake, data entry, reporting, invoicing preparation, reminders, status updates, and internal routing. Existing tools are reused where practical so the automation does not create unnecessary software overhead.

Automation handles only the predictable path. Missing information, validation failures, unexpected values, and sensitive decisions are surfaced to a person with enough context to act. Logs and run-level reporting make it possible to see what completed, what failed, and where the process needs adjustment.

Detail page: https://www.sarranai.com/workflow-automation.html

## How It Works

### About a week, and almost none of it yours

**Phase 1 — Discovery call** (45 minutes, recorded)
A conversation about how your week really goes. You talk, we listen for the friction.

**Phase 2 — Analysis** (Our time, not yours)
We work the whole conversation, find the strongest opportunities, and price every tool before it reaches your plan.

**Phase 3 — The plan** (Yours to keep)
Ranked opportunities, what each one saves, a four-day start plan, and the math behind the numbers.

**Phase 4 — Walk-through** (30 minutes)
We go through it together so you know what to do first — and whether you want a hand doing it.

## Why It Holds Up

### A demo proves it can work. Production proves it keeps working.

Most AI pilots stall on the same four things: tools called without boundaries, high-impact actions with no approval gate, evaluation that only grades the final answer, and cost that looks fine in a demo and breaks at volume. We design for all four before writing anything.

**A person confirms anything that matters**
Payments, refunds, cancellations, data changes — all gated behind explicit confirmation and deterministic validation. Never a model's inferred intent alone.

**Every tool is scoped and logged**
Least-privilege access on each integration. Your application code stays the source of truth for business rules — the agent never is.

**Only the data the step needs**
Personal data is masked, retention is policy-driven, and untrusted content is kept isolated from system instructions.

**Cost designed in, not discovered**
Cheap models for simple steps, stronger ones only where they change the outcome. Priced at production volume from day one.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is an AI Readiness Assessment?**
A 45-minute working session that identifies where AI can save time in your business. We analyze the workflow and deliver a written, ranked plan with practical opportunities, verified tool costs, and a four-day starting plan.

**What can an AI voice agent handle?**
An AI voice agent can answer inbound calls, qualify callers, book appointments into your existing calendar, conduct approved outbound follow-up and reminder calls, and provide transcripts and call-level reporting.

**How long does the assessment process take?**
The discovery call takes 45 minutes. We then complete the analysis and written plan, with the full assessment designed to take about one week and require very little additional time from you.

**Do you work with businesses outside Orlando?**
Yes. Sarran AI Solutions is based in Orlando, Florida and works with businesses across the United States.

**How are sensitive AI actions controlled?**
High-impact actions such as payments, refunds, cancellations, and data changes are designed with explicit human confirmation, deterministic validation, least-privilege tool access, and activity logging.

# AI Voice Agents for Business

Source: https://www.sarranai.com/ai-voice-agents.html
Title: AI Voice Agents for Business | Sarran AI Orlando

> AI voice agents that answer calls, qualify callers, book appointments, and preserve transcripts—with human escalation and production controls.

## Answer the call even when your team cannot.

AI voice agents · Orlando and nationwide

AI voice agents handle clearly defined conversations around the clock: answering approved questions, qualifying callers, booking appointments, and escalating what needs a person.

**Service facts:**

- 24/7 coverage — Inbound and approved outbound calls
- Calendar booking — Uses defined availability and rules
- Reviewable records — Transcripts and call-level reporting

## What an AI voice agent can handle

The agent is designed around a documented call flow, not an open-ended promise to handle every conversation. It can collect the right information consistently and move qualified callers toward an approved next step.

- Answer inbound calls during business hours or after hours
- Qualify callers with approved questions
- Book, confirm, or request appointments
- Run permitted reminders and follow-up calls
- Transfer or flag situations that need a person

## How production controls work

Before launch, we define what the agent may say, what data it may collect, which systems it may access, and where it must stop. Integrations use least-privilege access, sensitive actions require confirmation, and unexpected situations follow a human escalation path.

## Common business use cases

Voice agents are useful where missed calls or slow follow-up create lost opportunities: professional services, appointment-based businesses, property services, customer intake, internal help lines, and qualification workflows.

## AI voice agent questions

**Will callers know they are speaking with AI?**
The call opening and disclosure approach is defined with the client according to the use case and applicable requirements. We favor clear, honest experiences.

**Can it use our existing calendar?**
Yes, when the calendar exposes a suitable integration. Booking rules, availability, required fields, and exception behavior are documented first.

**What happens when the agent is uncertain?**
It follows a defined fallback such as transferring the call, creating a follow-up task, or telling the caller when a person will respond.

## Design the first call

### Start with one call type.

Bring the call your team misses most often. We will map the questions, booking rules, system access, and escalation path.

## Related AI Services

AI readiness assessment · Workflow automation · AI-integrated web development · Sarran AI Solutions home

© 2026 Sarran AI Solutions LLC.

# AI-Integrated Web Design & Development

Source: https://www.sarranai.com/ai-web-development.html
Title: AI Web Design & Development | Sarran AI Orlando

> Fast, accessible, SEO-ready business websites with focused AI qualification, routing, and answer capabilities built into real conversion paths.

## A fast business website with intelligence in the right places.

AI web development · Orlando and nationwide

We design accessible, SEO-ready websites around the visitor's decision path, then add AI only where it improves qualification, routing, or access to approved answers.

**Service facts:**

- Performance first — Core Web Vitals guide the build
- SEO-ready — Crawlable structure and metadata
- AI with a job — No decorative chatbot add-ons

## Designed around a real conversion path

The project begins with what a visitor must understand, which questions signal fit, and what action should happen next. Content, navigation, forms, and automation are organized around that path instead of a generic page template.

- Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile
- Semantic HTML and keyboard-accessible interactions
- Clear booking, inquiry, and qualification routes
- Maintainable content and documented deployment

## SEO, GEO, and answer-ready foundations

Every build includes the technical foundation search engines and answer systems need to understand the business. These measures improve crawlability and clarity but do not create unsupported ranking guarantees.

- Descriptive titles, metadata, headings, and canonical URLs
- Structured data representing the organization, services, and FAQs
- Intentional internal links, robots directives, and XML sitemap
- Fast loading, mobile usability, image metadata, and crawlable copy
- Direct factual passages suitable for traditional and AI-assisted search

## Purposeful AI integration

Suitable features include answering from approved business content, collecting structured qualification details, routing inquiries, or preparing information for a booking request. Deterministic rules stay in control of important actions.

## AI website questions

**Is ongoing SEO included?**
The build includes technical SEO. Ongoing search growth—research, new content, link acquisition, local citations, measurement, and iteration—is a separate continuing effort.

**Will I be able to update the site?**
The maintenance approach is agreed during planning. Routine content should not require a developer whenever the chosen platform can support safe editing.

**Can you improve an existing website?**
Yes, after reviewing its platform, performance, accessibility, search signals, content structure, and conversion path.

## Build the front door

### Start with the visitor journey.

Tell us what the right visitor needs to understand and what you want them to do next.

# AI Readiness Assessment

Source: https://www.sarranai.com/ai-readiness-assessment.html
Title: AI Readiness Assessment in Orlando | Sarran AI

> A practical AI readiness assessment: one 45-minute discovery call, ranked opportunities, verified tool costs, and a written action plan for your business.

## Know where AI belongs before you buy another tool.

AI assessment · Orlando and nationwide

The AI Readiness Assessment turns one working conversation into a ranked, written plan for saving time, improving response, and controlling implementation risk.

**Service facts:**

- 45 minutes — One focused discovery call
- 3–7 opportunities — Ranked by value and effort
- About one week — From discovery to walkthrough

## What an AI readiness assessment evaluates

We map recurring tasks, handoffs, delays, customer-response gaps, and the systems involved in a normal working week. Each opportunity is evaluated for likely time saved, implementation effort, recurring cost, data sensitivity, and required human oversight.

- Repetitive administrative and customer-facing work
- Information copied between forms, inboxes, spreadsheets, and business systems
- Response delays, missed calls, reporting effort, and follow-up gaps
- Actions that should remain human-controlled

## What you receive

The deliverable is a decision document you own—not a generic maturity score or sales deck. It explains which opportunities should come first, what they require, and which ideas should wait.

- Three to seven ranked AI or automation opportunities
- Verified software costs and implementation dependencies
- Risk, oversight, and exception-handling considerations
- A practical four-day plan for the first approved opportunity

## Who it is for

The assessment is designed for established businesses that know work is being lost to repetitive tasks but do not want to start with a platform purchase. Sarran AI Solutions is based in Orlando, Florida and works with organizations across the United States.

## AI readiness assessment questions

**Do we need technical preparation?**
No. Bring a clear description of how work currently moves through the business. Technical follow-up is requested only when it changes a recommendation.

**Are we required to hire Sarran AI to implement the plan?**
No. The written plan belongs to the client and can be implemented internally, by another provider, or with Sarran AI Solutions.

**Does every recommendation use generative AI?**
No. Some problems are better solved with deterministic automation, clearer routing, or a process change. The assessment recommends the simplest suitable approach.

## Start here

### Bring one frustrating workflow.

We will use the discovery call to understand the work, the systems involved, and what a useful outcome would look like.

# Business Workflow Automation

Source: https://www.sarranai.com/workflow-automation.html
Title: Business Workflow Automation | Sarran AI Orlando

> Workflow automation for intake, data movement, reporting, invoicing preparation, reminders, and follow-up—with logging and human exception handling.

## Move routine work without another manual handoff.

Workflow automation · Orlando and nationwide

Workflow automation connects repeatable steps across the tools your business already uses, completes the predictable path, and gives exceptions back to a person.

**Service facts:**

- Event or schedule — Runs when the defined trigger occurs
- Human exceptions — Unexpected cases are escalated
- Run-level visibility — See what completed and what failed

## Good workflow automation candidates

A good candidate repeats often, follows stable rules, uses information that can be validated, and has a clear owner when something unusual occurs.

- Form intake and structured record creation
- Data movement between approved business systems
- Scheduled reports and status summaries
- Appointment reminders and follow-up sequences
- Invoicing preparation and document routing
- Internal notifications, assignments, and approvals

## How an automation is designed

We document the trigger, required inputs, validation rules, permitted system access, expected output, and exception path before implementation. This keeps the system understandable and prevents an automation from silently making decisions outside its role.

## Reliability and governance

Connections use the minimum access necessary. Runs are logged, failures surface with context, sensitive actions remain gated, and the business retains a manual fallback for critical work.

## Workflow automation questions

**Where should we start?**
Start with a task that happens frequently, consumes measurable time, follows consistent rules, and is frustrating but not dangerous to test with human review.

**Can automation include AI?**
Yes, for bounded tasks such as classification, extraction, summarization, or drafting. Deterministic rules should control permissions, validation, and consequential actions.

**How is success measured?**
Measures may include handling time, completed runs, exception rate, response time, rework, and operating cost. The useful metric depends on the workflow.

## Map one workflow

### Bring the repetitive task.

We will identify the trigger, systems, rules, output, and the exceptions that still need a person.

# AI Answering Service for Dental Practices

Source: https://www.sarranai.com/ai-voice-agent-dental-practices.html
Title: AI Answering Service for Dental Practices | Sarran AI Orlando

> Never miss a patient call. AI answering service for dental practices: emergency triage, booking, insurance-question routing, and after-hours coverage.

## Never miss another patient call.

AI answering service for dental practices · Orlando and nationwide

An AI voice agent built around a dental front desk: it answers after-hours emergencies, books and reschedules appointments, triages insurance questions, and calls back the patients who couldn't get through.

**Service facts:**

- 24/7 coverage — After-hours and overflow patient calls
- Emergency triage — Flags urgent cases for a defined callback
- Missed-call recovery — Calls back instead of going to voicemail

## What an AI answering service handles for a dental office

A front desk is often unavailable exactly when the phone rings: mid-procedure, at lunch, or after closing. The agent is built around a documented call flow for your practice, not an open-ended promise to handle every conversation.

- Answer inbound calls during business hours and after hours
- Triage dental emergencies against criteria you define
- Book, confirm, and reschedule appointments
- Route insurance and billing questions it isn't authorized to answer
- Call back missed calls and voicemails instead of leaving them unanswered
- Collect new-patient intake details and hand off a structured summary to staff

## How production controls work for a dental practice

Before launch, we define what the agent may say about clinical topics, insurance coverage, and pricing, which systems it may access, and where it must stop. Anything resembling a dental emergency — severe pain, swelling, trauma, uncontrolled bleeding — follows an escalation path you approve, not a scripted guess.

## Why this matters for dental practices specifically

Two of the highest-value calls a practice can lose are the after-hours emergency and the new patient who hangs up rather than leaving a voicemail. This is the same call-handling problem we use as our own example of what a voice agent can do — we hear it constantly from dental offices exploring AI.

## AI answering service for dental offices — questions

**Can it handle emergency triage vs. routine scheduling?**
Yes. Before launch we define what counts as a dental emergency for your practice — for example severe pain, swelling, trauma, or uncontrolled bleeding — and route those calls immediately per your escalation protocol, while routine scheduling, rescheduling, and confirmations are handled by the agent directly.

**Does it integrate with our practice management or scheduling system?**
Yes, when your system exposes a suitable integration. Booking rules, available slots, and required fields are documented first. Where an integration isn't available, the agent captures a structured message and a team member confirms the appointment.

**What happens with insurance questions it can't answer?**
The agent does not guess about coverage, benefits, or claims. It collects the caller's insurance details and question, then routes the call to staff or schedules a callback, based on rules you approve in advance.

**Will patients know they're speaking with AI?**
The call opening and disclosure approach is defined with your practice according to your preferences and applicable requirements. We favor clear, honest experiences.

**Can it recover calls we miss?**
Yes. When a call goes unanswered or a voicemail is left, the agent can call back, capture the reason for the call, and either book the appointment directly or hand a structured summary to staff.

## Start with your after-hours line.

Bring the call your practice misses most — after-hours emergencies, lunch coverage, or the calls that go to voicemail. We will map the triage rules, booking flow, and escalation path.
